items.q: Yes, he had come later. He'd gotten there in the '40s, the mid-'40s or close to the mid-'40s, he'd come to New York. And he'd started a show called This Is Jazz.

ctx.x: But they were interested, very interested. And it was like a bunch.
Was Rudi Blesh around then, too?

Yes, he had come later. He'd gotten there in the '40s, the mid-'40s or close to the mid-'40s, he'd come to New York. And he'd started a show called This Is Jazz.
